nodes.label: Personal Finance Agent Beta
nodes.rationale: Framework-free local finance assistant using validated ledger data and a hand-written tool loop.

nodes.label: Manual Reason Act Observe Loop
nodes.rationale: Six-step loop has recoverable malformed tool calls and avoids an agent framework.

nodes.label: Jev Context Compaction
nodes.rationale: Jev selects old complete tool-call/result pairs while retaining canonical history; summary is used when Jev cannot reduce context by at least five percent.

nodes.label: Turn Based Compaction Threshold
nodes.rationale: React compacts context by user turn, defaulting to 15 turns with Settings-constrained values from 5 through 100; model requests receive a fresh prepared copy after the threshold.

nodes.label: Chat Thread JSON Records
nodes.rationale: Each chat persists as an owner-readable local JSON record with atomic replacement; persistence stores uploaded financial data and is deliberately local single-user state.

nodes.label: Decimal Budget Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Confirmed rules are evaluated over the ledger with exact Decimal arithmetic; unsupported rules return insufficient_evidence rather than a guess.

nodes.label: Same Origin MCP Proxy
nodes.rationale: Nginx serves the React app and proxies same-origin MCP traffic so provider keys remain only in the MCP process.

nodes.label: ChatStore
nodes.rationale: A small ChatStore beside SessionStore provides durable threads without a REST layer, database, authentication system, or agent framework.

nodes.label: Pending Turn Recovery
nodes.rationale: The first ask writes a pending turn before provider invocation, atomically finalizes it afterward, and exposes restart-interrupted pending work instead of silently dropping it.

nodes.label: Context Inspector Audit Receipt
nodes.rationale: Before and model-input panes reveal Jev keep, trim, and drop decisions while demonstrating that the canonical history is not mutated.

nodes.label: React Browser MCP Client
nodes.rationale: React talks directly to the existing Python MCP backend; no FastAPI, REST translation layer, database, or second agent framework is added because MCP already supplies the typed UI-facing contract.

nodes.label: Complete Response Delivery
nodes.rationale: Chat answers remain complete AgentResult values; token streaming would change the provider, agent loop, MCP contract, context-report timing, tests, and UI protocol.

nodes.label: State Ownership
nodes.rationale: MCP process memory owns sessions, ledger, canonical messages and locks; React page memory owns view state; localStorage retains only rule preferences.

nodes.label: Same Origin MCP Transport
nodes.rationale: The browser uses /mcp while Nginx forwards POST, GET and DELETE to the MCP service, preserves response headers, disables buffering, and keeps MCP_UPSTREAM out of browser configuration.

nodes.label: Decimal Display Boundary
nodes.rationale: Browser types accept Decimal values as strings or numbers but JavaScript never performs financial arithmetic; Python Decimal remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Rule Workflow State Machine
nodes.rationale: React must explicitly coordinate controlled inputs, signatures, parsed and confirmed rules, and resets because Streamlit rerun behavior is not retained.

nodes.label: Safe Markdown Rendering
nodes.rationale: Assistant Markdown is untrusted presentation data and must render without raw HTML; React text nodes replace manual HTML escaping in the context panel.

nodes.label: Local Single User Boundary
nodes.rationale: Public hosting, multi-user operation, horizontal scaling, durable shared storage, token streaming, CDN-only UI, and schema generation are future decisions rather than current scope.

nodes.label: Achromatic Interface
nodes.rationale: Near-white, near-black and calibrated grayscale create hierarchy; blue is reserved for interaction and other colors are small data-status indicators rather than decoration.

nodes.label: Shadow As Border
nodes.rationale: Box-shadow replaces CSS borders to avoid layout shift, compose layers, animate smoothly, and provide multiple surface rings.

nodes.label: Accessible Native Controls
nodes.rationale: Native semantic controls and visible focus treatments support the restrained developer-tooling design language.
